scenarios.name: Focus a command property while a pinned panel is expanded

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon displays the Modify panel
the user starts Shell from Modify
the user opens and pins the Modify additional-command area
the additional commands and Shell properties are both visible
the user clicks the Shell thickness field
the thickness value is selected in the field
the pinned additional-command area remains visible
the Shell properties panel and model preview remain visible
the command properties and preview close
the original solid block remains visible
the pinned additional-command area remains visible
the user unpins the additional-command area
the user clicks its Modify title
